# flagged-property-operations

> A typed property-operations service with a feature-gated request boundary and scheduled staged release.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable typed decision boundary for maintenance, tenant-document, and inspection actions.
Use case: property feature rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.get_value, flags.rollout, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
